codestral-2501.reason: Mistral's Codestral 25.01 checkpoint (early 2025, 256K context, FIM coding model, per Mistral's own release); the index has only Codestral-22B-v0.1 and Codestral 25.08, so the 25.01 revision has no entry.

codex-mini.reason: Matches OpenAI's codex-mini-latest, the o4-mini fine-tune for Codex CLI (200K context, $1.50/$6 official rates, text+image input); the index has no o4-mini-based Codex entry — gpt-5.1-codex-mini is a different, later model.

cohere-embed-v3-english.reason: Azure AI Foundry serves Cohere's Embed v3 English (embed-english-v3.0, 512-token window, $0.10/1M on Azure per Microsoft Marketplace); same model as cohere/embed-english-v3.0.

cohere-embed-v3-multilingual.reason: Azure AI Foundry serves Cohere's Embed v3 Multilingual (embed-multilingual-v3.0, 512-token window, 100+ languages per Microsoft Marketplace); same model as cohere/embed-multilingual-v3.0.

deepseek-v3.2-speciale.reason: DeepSeek-V3.2-Speciale (Dec 2025) is a separate high-compute variant of DeepSeek-V3.2 with scaled post-training reinforcement learning (per DeepSeek's own release notes); the index has no Speciale entry, so defer rather than link to deepseek/deepseek-v3.2.
